lead.title: MintNeuro (Imperial College spin-out) raises $5M led by Odyssey Ventures for chips built for neural implants
lead.deck: The London company designs chips purpose-built for devices that interface with the brain and nervous system, rather than generic components not designed for implantation. It has already delivered working silicon and hit integration milestones with Motif Neurotech and Amber Therapeutics: an infrastructure building block for brain-computer interfaces. Round announced October 7 and not previously covered; quiet week, few fresh European announcements this weekend.

milestone.title: Medtronic presents real-world data at APHRS 2026 on its PulseSelect and Affera/Sphere-9 ablation systems
milestone.summary: The REAL PULSE study (1,160 atrial fibrillation patients, 38 centres) reports a 0.09% acute major complication rate; the APEX registry (1,050 patients, 28 sites) 1.1%. In ventricular tachycardia, the European APEX cohort (46 patients) shows 87% acute success and about 75% freedom from recurrence at six months.
milestone.why: Pulsed field ablation is becoming a real-world evidence market: these figures set the benchmark European PFA challengers will have to match.

brefsEurope.title: Getinge wins FDA 510(k) for an Edi catheter for premature infants and launches Cardiohelp II in CE-marked markets
brefsEurope.summary: The Edi catheter targets newborns of 500 to 1,000 g on Getinge ventilators; Cardiohelp II begins launching in CE-recognising markets. In Q3, adjusted EBITA margin was 15.1% (13.1% a year earlier) on 2.1% organic growth, with 3-5% guidance unchanged.

word.definition: An independent organisation designated by an EU member state that audits a medical device and issues the certificate without which CE marking is impossible for higher risk classes.

how.t: The manufacturer builds its technical and clinical documentation under MDR 2017/745.
The notified body reviews the file and audits the manufacturer's quality system.
It issues the CE certificate, then provides ongoing surveillance (annual audits, product changes).

word.why: Certification lead time (12 to 18 months per Tech.eu) is a bottleneck that pushes revenue out: knowing which body handles which startup is a timing signal for an investor.
